name: Tell Me
source:
A short story about an unlucky crook demon and a boy who can see ghosts. Is everything as simple as it seems at first glance?

[From [url=https://cyborg-cant-eat-pizza.itch.io/tell-me]itch.io[/url]]

一个关于一个不幸的骗子恶魔和一个能看到鬼魂的男孩的短篇故事。一切真的像乍看起来那么简单吗？

[来自[url=https://cyborg-cant-eat-pizza.itch.io/tell-me]itch.io[/url]]
